title: 부서진 하늘
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished story-stage landscape illustration, without any title or lettering. Opaque wide 16:9 at the largest available landscape resolution, intended for downscaling to 640x360 and display at 360-480px width. Reference 1 is the game's painted pixel-art style anchor; reference 2 is its story painting style; reference 3 is this realm's palette, architecture and landmarks. All are reference inputs, not edit targets. Match the crisp visible painted pixel clusters and stepped silhouettes, rich but controlled colour, layered fantasy depth; no photographic or smooth 3D rendering. Cohesive nine-picture set rules: wide level establishing view, one dominant landmark centred horizontally in the MIDDLE THIRD, skyline/horizon around 70-74% image height in the LOWER THIRD, key environmental light from UPPER LEFT, midtone readability with dark blue-violet shadows, moderate saturation and contrast comparable to the other realms. Simple large shapes readable in a thumbnail. The outermost 3% on every side must be low-detail calm scenery safe for an 8px frame overlap, but DO NOT draw a frame. Keep the entire landmark in view. No people, human faces, humanoid figures, statues, letters, text-like decoration, glyphs, runes, numerals, logo, watermark, UI, borders or frames. No text anywhere. Stage 1, take B. A HUMAN TOWN of steep timber rooftops at DUSK, under a sky SPLIT by irregular glowing pink-gold cracks, with distant drifting realm islands. Use the blue-grey slate, amber windows, ochre dusk and muted teal distance from reference 3. Take B is a genuinely different view: across a broad quiet river toward a concentrated cluster of tall RED-BROWN gabled rooftops and a single central needle-like stone bell tower with no dial; the roof cluster is the one clear middle-third landmark and the river/horizon is at y72%. A large diagonal fissure enters from upper left and forks toward upper middle; three distant small realm islands drift toward the right, clearly detached rocky undersides. More open sky and water than take A; central landmark still comparable in size to the rest of the set. Upper-left sunset lights the towers. No bridges dominating the view, no clocks, no banners, no signs and no inhabitants.
